NoteNlpAccessor::remove_footers¶

Back to Note NLP Accessor API Reference

Signature¶

Note NoteNlpAccessor::remove_footers() const

Remove Repeated Page And Rights Lines¶

remove_footers() deletes complete lines that match a compact footer grammar. It is useful after page extraction, where page labels or publication notices recur inside otherwise useful prose. Unlike remove_boilerplate(), it does not search for policy phrases in arbitrary positions; its rights and confidentiality forms must begin the trimmed line.

Footer family

Complete line rule

Page number

page, one or more ASCII digits, and optionally of plus one or more digits

Copyright

Trimmed line starts with the complete word copyright or with ©

Rights

Trimmed line starts with all rights reserved as complete words

Confidentiality

Trimmed line starts with the complete word confidential

Matching is ASCII case-insensitive and permits surrounding whitespace. The page-number rule requires numeric digits: page three remains. Word boundaries protect copyrighted and confidentiality, so ordinary prose beginning with those longer words is not discarded. Once a rights-style prefix matches, the rest of that line may contain years, owners, punctuation, or qualifiers.

If at least one footer line is deleted, surviving lines are joined through collapsed ASCII whitespace and stripped. If none matches, the original cell is returned exactly. A footer-only cell becomes "" while retaining its position in the Note. Processing is out-of-place, shape-preserving, cell-independent, and Text-only; undefined, empty, and invalid-dtype behavior matches the other NLP removers.

Example 1: All Footer Families¶

std::cout << pluss::note::print(
    pluss::note::make({
        "Body line\nPage 3 of 9\nConfidential - internal\n"
        "© 2026 Pluss\nCopyright 2026 Pluss\n"
        "All rights reserved\nClosing"})
        .nlp().remove_footers()) << '\n';

Output¶

Note(shape=[1], dim=1, numel=1, encoding=utf8)
["Body line Closing"]

Example 2: Similar Vocabulary Is Not Enough¶

std::cout << pluss::note::print(
    pluss::note::make({"  page three\nconfidentiality matters  "})
        .nlp().remove_footers()) << '\n';

Output¶

Note(shape=[1], dim=1, numel=1, encoding=utf8)
["  page three\nconfidentiality matters  "]

Example 3: Footer-Only Cells Become Empty, Not Absent¶

const auto matrix = pluss::note::make(
    std::vector<std::string>{"a@b.io", "Page 1", "#tag", "<b>bold</b>"},
    std::array<std::int64_t, 2>{2, 2});
std::cout << pluss::note::print(matrix.nlp().remove_footers()) << '\n';

Output¶

Note(shape=[2, 2], dim=2, numel=4, encoding=utf8)
[
  ["a@b.io", ""], 
  ["#tag", "<b>bold</b>"]
]
